prompt:
Task: HD remaster of a sheet of animation frames from the 1995 adventure game The Dig (LucasArts), in the smooth, detailed style approved for the main characters. This is a production asset. Every frame is fitted to the original frame's size and position afterwards, and the game lays it over the HD background with its own soft edges.

Input: the attached image is the original low-resolution sheet enlarged 4x with hard pixel edges. The frames stand apart on a plain flat cyan background (#00C8C8). Around the sheet is a plain gray (#808080) border. The border is only padding.

All frames on this sheet are animation frames of the same characters (Boston Low and Ludger Brink), as one scene, in different poses. On this sheet, row by row from left to right: animation 6, facing right (10 frames); animation 8, facing right (3 frames); animation 10, facing right (10 frames).

Do:
- Repaint every frame in high resolution with clean, natural detail: smooth shading instead of dithering, smooth anti-aliased outlines (no pixel steps), believable cloth, skin, hair and material.
- Keep the original look: the same character, the same colors, light direction, shadows and contrast, in the painted style of the approved HD sheets.
- Make all frames look identical apart from the pose: the same face, hair, clothes, colors and light in every frame. The frames are played one after another in the game, so any difference between them flickers.
- Keep the pose, proportions and silhouette of every frame as in the input, and keep each frame in its place on the sheet, in the same rows and the same order.
- Glowing effects (light, energy, lightning, sparks) are painted as soft glow that fades into transparency.

Do not:
- Do not add, remove, merge or redesign frames. Do not add anything between the frames: no shadows, floor, text, numbers, labels, frames or grid lines.
- Do not let frames touch or overlap each other.
- Some frames show only part of the character, for example a body without a head or a head alone, because the game draws the parts separately. Paint them as they are and do not complete them.
- Small bright magenta marks under the feet or at the edges are shadow markers used by the game. Leave them out; the game draws the shadow itself.
- No photorealism, no modern 3D look, no film grain, no vignette, no watermark, no signature.

Output: one PNG image, exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels, with a fully transparent background (real alpha, no background color and no gray border) and the frames in the same layout as the input. List the delivery with its sha256 in the fremdrift.json of your report and add a rutekart (the box around each frame's drawing) as for the main characters.

If a second image is attached, it is an already approved HD sheet of the same character, or an approved HD picture from the same game. Paint the character exactly as in that image: the same face, hair, clothes, colors and level of detail. Take all poses and the layout from the first image.


TOM-AUTHORIZED PRECISE SOURCE/STYLE CORRECTION, 10 OCTOBER 2026:
Image ONE is the actual original source animation sheet and controls ALL poses, angle, clothing, palette, light, animation phases, silhouette and crops. Image TWO is Tom's approved Brink face identity and clean smooth drawn style, ONLY for the source heads that are actually visible; it never authorizes adding a head where source has none. Image THREE is Maggie's source concept face, ONLY her feminine identity and short black bob; use the same clean smooth2D drawn shading as the approved Brink. Image FOUR is a factual guide made from actual originalRGBA, showing exact main-frame IDs and real silhouette; no labels or gray background in output. The old generic metadata is incomplete: actual people on THIS sheet are Maggie and partially cropped Brink, not an all-Boston/all-Brink scene. Never turn Maggie into a man or draw Boston here.

EXACTLY FOUR ROWS [8,2,3,9], TWENTY-TWO main source units in original layout/order. ONE genuine tiny original fragment055 is a single darkgray opaque originalpixel and is retained separately from originalRGBA by import; do NOT expand it into a head, body or new drawing. Keep all source intentional lower-body cuts and headless/near-headless boundaries literally.
Row1 exactly8 alternating source units: (1)037 Maggie bending forward with arms lowered ahead; (2)038 SOURCE PARTIAL BRINK TORSO, gray jacket and source arms stretched ahead/right, lower body cropped and the head ALMOST ENTIRELY ABSENT behind the source boundary; (3)039 Maggie next forward-arm/bent phase; (4)040 partial Brink torso with source arms lifted forward/right; (5)041 Maggie with bent raised arms in front; (6)042 partial Brink torso with arms reaching upward/right; (7)043 Maggie hands raised near her own face; (8)020 partial Brink torso in the next raised-reaching phase. On the four Brink torso units, retain ONLY the tiny authentic dark/tan/blond rim/stub visible at the source upper boundary. Do NOT complete that rim into a face/head/hairdo. No whole normal Brink head above these torso pieces. No extra legs/boots below them. Exact source forearms/hands, source angular bent-back outline and truncated base.
Row2 exactly2 drawings:045 Maggie then019 Maggie, upright in the precise distinct source arms-across-front/raised gesture phases. Original white shirt opening/rolled sleeves and small violet patch stay in their own source visibility.
Row3 exactly3 drawings:047,048,018, each the SOURCE PARTIAL BRINK GRAY TORSO with source forearm/hand raised beside the clipped head boundary. Preserve the tiny genuine tan/blond top rim and dark neck/undershirt fragments AS FRAGMENTS, no full head or face added, no completed lower legs. Keep all three different hand states, not cloned torso pose.
Row4 exactly9 drawings: first FIVE are Maggie050,051,052,053,017 alone, in exact successive arm-lowering/hand-to-hip/arms-down source phases; lower trousers stop at original crop, no boots/feet. Sixth056 is another PARTIAL NEAR-HEADLESS BRINK TORSO with arm out ahead and tiny authentic top rim, no completed head. Last THREE057,058,059 show Brink's actual blond head reappearing above the partial gray torso in exact three successive leaning phases. ONLY these last three have a normal visible full head, tilted exactly as the source, and the gray torso/lower-body crops still remain. Do not use the face anchor to add normal heads to earlier torso-only units.

Source clothing/palette always wins. Brink is lean, long narrow angular scientist face, long straight nose, narrow chin, neat muted straw blond hair and restrained brows when the source head is visible. Jacket BLUEGRAY #7F8793/#4B4B5B, darknavy undershirt#0B0B1F, trousers DARK RUST #8F2F00/#6B2307/#431300 only in the little source-visible portions, muted warm skin#CF876B/#976F6B and source hair ochre#D79F4F. Maggie short BLACK bob, natural warm source skin, burnt-orange jumpsuit#BB4700/#9B370B/#772700 with source rolled sleeves, WHITE undershirt opening and original small darkblue/violet chest patch. Every original gesture and local visibility of hands/white shirt/patch stays exact, not all cloned. No olive-green lighting from costume174, no new tears, gear or props.

Smooth high-resolution 2D adventure animation with clean confident dark contours and restrained angular drawn shading; gently soften pixel edges only, keep same source shape and proportions. No 3D plastic, photographic texture or inflated superhero proportions. Exact1536x1024 nativeRGBA transparent PNG. Empty gaps, no cyan/gray padding, grids, ID labels, floor/shadow, vignette, colored haze, halo field, magenta markers or stray color dots. Do not paint reconstructed hidden parts or decorative detail where the source is cropped.
